item.title: Project Mountaintop dev log: First Steps - Week 1→2 Recap
item.description: Starting Project Mountaintop’s rhythm game from scratch in Unity: a modular rhythm system, ghosts, and a hilariously buggy first prototype.

item.description: MIDI-driven beatmaps, music, combos, SFX and the first standalone build of Project Mountaintop, plus playtester and mentor feedback.

item.description: T9Hacks week: a space theme, a new UI, a Hans Zimmer beatmap made in 15 minutes, and a humbling attempt at 3D character modelling.

item.title: Project Mountaintop dev log: Danny - Mentor Extraordinaire
item.description: Playtest feedback from mentor Danny that shaped Project Mountaintop: the hiking pole controls, polish priorities and a six-input scheme.
